title: Serbia Microgreens Market — HoReCa Entry Assessment
business_question: Is there a commercially attractive opportunity to supply premium locally grown microgreens to HoReCa customers in Serbia, and what should the initial market-entry strategy be?
objectives: Assess the Serbian microgreens market size and maturity.
Estimate HoReCa demand and adoption potential.
Understand restaurant and chef usage patterns.
Define relevant geography and distribution channels.
Identify buyer requirements and procurement criteria.
context: Commercial desk research for local premium microgreens supply.
